summary: Iteration 45 — Phase 1 quick-fix testing (backend + frontend). All 5 backend pytest tests passed (organization_forms in /options/all + /settings/manageable-lists, organization_form persistence on POST/PUT /api/companies, PUT /api/invitations/{id}/notes save & propagation through GET /api/invitations, plus 404 negative case). Frontend smoke verified 5/6 UI changes: company-org-form dropdown shows MMC/ASC/QSC; Assembly modal — outside click & ESC do NOT close, X click triggers confirm() with expected Azerbaijani message, label 'İclasın keçirildiyi tarix' visible, data-testid='assembly-deadline' present; Tasks page renders 6 cards with data-testid='task-card-*'; Finance Income filter 'Müəssisə' (filter-marsol-company) renders after expanding Filtrlər and lists 'Hamısı, Marsol Group, Marsol Events, Marsol Media, Marsol Academy'; Finance Expense modal has data-testid='expense-responsible-person' as Radix Select (combobox role). Could NOT verify invitation-note inputs in Organization module from simple table row click — likely requires opening an event detail/edit modal which has different click flow.

integration_issues.flow: Finance → Xərc əlavə et → Məsul şəxs
integration_issues.issue: Dropdown renders only 1 option ('Seçilməyib'). Either responsiblePersons fetch returns empty in this env (no system users + əməkdaşlar configured), OR the merge of users+employees into the Select is not populating. Verify by checking Network tab for /api/users and /api/employees calls when modal opens — if both return data but options are still 1, there's a mapping bug in Finance.jsx.

design_issues.screen: Multiple modals (Yeni İclas, Xərc əlavə et, Yeni şirkət)
issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — accessibility warning on every modal open. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby.

action_items: Verify Finance Expense modal's responsible-person Select actually populates with system users + əməkdaşlar — currently only 'Seçilməyib' visible. Check fetch logic and useEffect dependency in Finance.jsx around responsiblePersons state.

Confirm invitation-note inline input is reachable in Organization module — testing agent could not reach it via simple event-row click on /activities. Main agent should clarify the user flow (probably click event title or pencil-edit to open invitation list panel) and add data-testid hooks at the entry-point so it is automatable.
Add <DialogDescription> to Radix Dialogs to suppress accessibility console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/invitations/{id}/notes accepts arbitrary dict — consider Pydantic InvitationNotesUpdate(BaseModel) with notes: str = Field(max_length=2000) for input validation and to prevent payload bloat.

Companies model accepts 'organization_form' as free-form string — backend does NOT validate against the organization_forms list. If a typo is sent (e.g. 'Mmc'), it will be saved as-is. Acceptable for flexibility but consider validation on POST/PUT against /options/all['organization_forms'] for data quality.
server.py is now 6131 lines — continued growth. Past iteration_44 already flagged this; consider routers/companies_router.py + routers/invitations_router.py + routers/settings_router.py extraction.
Optimistic update pattern in Tasks.jsx (handleStatusChange) — verify rollback logic on API failure preserves prior column position (was unable to simulate 5xx in test env).
Assembly modal: confirm() native dialog blocks the event loop and is hard to style. Consider a custom AlertDialog component (Radix already in stack) for consistency.
Finance Expense responsible-person merging — if duplicate names across users + employees, ensure unique key in <SelectItem key={id|name}> to avoid React key collisions.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 verified visually; 1 — invitation-note — needs user-flow clarification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 1 quick-fixes are fully validated. Frontend: organization_form dropdown, Assembly modal close-protection (outside click, ESC, X-with-confirm), Tasks data-testids, Finance Müəssisə filter, and Expense responsible-person Select component are all wired. Two open items: (1) responsiblePersons Select shows only 'Seçilməyib' — likely no users/employees fixture in env or merge bug in Finance.jsx — needs network-tab inspection; (2) /activities page lists events but clicking a row didn't surface invitation-note inputs — flow likely requires opening event edit/detail modal. Source code grep confirms data-testid='invitation-note-${inv.id}' exists in Organization.jsx line 540 — component is built, just needs correct entry point.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The two unverified frontend points are due to environment data state (empty responsibles list) or test-flow gaps (event-detail entry path), not code defects.
